entries.definition: DARVO (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender): denying the conduct occurred, attacking the person who raised it, then reversing victim/offender roles.
Triangulation: routing conflict or messages through a third party (often the child) instead of direct communication between parents.
Hoovering: an attempt to draw a person back into contact after a period of distance or conflict, typically timed around a hearing or mediation date.
